summary: Listed in a 2016 table of Georgia lookout towers at Townsend, McIntosh County; no history or site description found.

evidence.supports: Table row: Townsend tower, McIntosh County, 26 ft elevation, Georgia Forestry Commission number 132
The table was revised in March 2016

notes_for_editor: Stub. The only source is a 2016 table that places a tower at Townsend and gives its coordinates, elevation and GFC number. It gives no build date, staffing, condition or access. Two web searches, the Wikipedia article on Townsend, the McIntosh County historic resources survey (Phase Two) and the GFC history PDF found nothing on this tower. Grokipedia's Townsend article is an AI-written wiki and mentions no tower, so it was not used. Editor decision needed: hold the stub until GFC tower records or a McIntosh County historical source is checked, or publish it as a short stub. The 2016 table is not proof the tower still stands. The table gives no unit label; feet is inferred from its values (the Brasstown row reads 4735, which only fits feet).
